test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aware**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aware **means having knowledge or consciousness; being cognizant or mindful of something. (ज्ञान या चेतना होना; किसी चीज़ के प्रति सचेत या जागरूक होना)

 
 
• **Example: ***She was aware of the importance of time management, so she carefully planned her schedule to meet deadlines.*
 
 
 
• "**aware**" is the appropriate word for the blank as it underscores the importance of making the public knowledgeable about the consequences of reckless driving.

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Accuse: **To charge someone with a wrongdoing; to claim that someone has committed an offense. (किसी पर गलत काम का आरोप लगाना; यह दावा करने के लिए कि किसी ने अपराध किया है)
 
• **Adhere: **To stick or cling to something; to follow or remain loyal to a practice or belief. (किसी चीज़ से चिपकना या चिपटना; किसी प्रथा या विश्वास का पालन करना या उसके प्रति वफादार रहना)
 
• **Avenge: **To seek revenge or retaliate, especially on behalf of oneself or others. (बदला लेने या प्रतिशोध लेने के लिए, विशेष रूप से स्वयं या दूसरों की ओर से)
